item.tib: sngags kyi mdo 'dur rin chen phreng ba mu cho'i khrom 'dur chen mo las rin chen phreng ba gzhung gi mtshan bon g.yen sde 'dul lo
item.coloph: sems can don du rin chen sngags 'di bris/ 'gal 'khrul mchis na bzod par gsol/ dge rtsa gang mchis sems can don du bsngo/ mdo sde 'dur ba'i rgyud/ mu cho ldem drug gi lung*/ gsang ba rin chen sngags 'dur rdzogs so//
